items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1973-03-16
items.q: Dutch Andrus, who had a little store on Oak Street, used to collect for me, all the Louis Armstrong records we could find

ctx.x: What was the question? I'm lost.

The question is, was there much attempt on part of white, legitimate musicians to play in a Negro style? Well there's no doubt that the white musicians who could play were influenced by their style. But to my positive knowledge, the Negro musicians didn't seem to have the schooling or the technique that the musicians had before they started to play jazz, you see? And that gave us a chance to perhaps improve or modernize in those days their style of music. But their music was always good. And I used to take a leaf…
But did you know Louis Armstrong? Did you ever know him?
